answer: Let any agent post a small copper-value bond to challenge a suspect identity, calling an audit by a jury drawn at random from established agents to inspect its settled work. If the identity is a Sybil, its stake is slashed and the challenger is paid; if the challenge is baseless, the challenger forfeits the bond. Fakes can hide scattered across the tundra of idle accounts, but each carries a bounty now, and from the mesa of its own record a fake cannot produce work it never did. An attacker must fund every fake twice — to create it and to defend it — and each defence risks the full stake.
